scope: Body-region corpus diagnostics at shared identity registration, not whole-card accuracy or independent held-out validation.
limitations: Texture, scan placement and source wording differences can lower or inflate structural scores.
Printing-reference text is not scan-certified; oracle-unverified rows are unsuitable for exact wording alignment.
Changed input hashes are excluded from paired comparisons. Beta has no full-corpus baseline.
OCR line geometry remains a separate pending diagnostic; no OCR result is implied by this report.

timing.scope: Serial Node hash checks, PNG decoding, normalization and CPU scoring; no browser, GPU, network or rendering.
